note: Seeded defects on branch feature/bulk-import (diff against main). A finding earns credit for a defect only when it names one of the defect's files, points within `tolerance` lines of one of its ranges (or gives no line), and uses one of its keywords. Each defect is credited to at most one finding (maximum matching). knownOther lists real defects that were not seeded: matching findings are reported as valid extras, not as seeded credit and not as noise.

defects.title: Import stops at the first blank line and silently drops every later row
POST /events/bulk reads the whole body with no size limit (readJson enforces maxBodyBytes; this path bypasses it)
importEvents mutates the shared DEFAULT_OPTIONS object, so stats accumulate across calls and requests
Bulk import records each row under the key in the payload instead of the caller's x-api-key, so a caller can bill usage to other keys

knownOther.title: maxRows is checked after earlier rows are recorded, so the import is partial before the 400
A JSON line that parses to null or a primitive throws outside the try, giving a 500 after partial import
Concatenating chunks as strings corrupts multi-byte UTF-8 at chunk boundaries
A numeric `at` (milliseconds), which POST /events accepts, is rejected because Date.parse(number) is NaN
The endpoint returns 200 even when every row failed
Tests miss blank lines, defaults, size limits or key handling
